What if humanity has been invited to look beyond Earth—and rethink its place in the universe?

LISTEN TO THE FULL INTERVIEW HERE > https://open.spotify.com/episode/03YaXib9jhiuNDcaXsGZ20

In a new episode of The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast, bestselling paranormal author G. L. Davies welcomes galactic contactee and Powerful Galactic Beings author Fulcrum Djedi to discuss the possibility of contact with extraterrestrial life.

Titled “GET READY: The GALACTIC Community’s Message for Humanity!”, the 45-minute episode explores what Djedi calls a “galactic invitation.” Together, Davies and his guest discuss alien species, ancient civilisations and the ideas behind Djedi’s books. What might a message for humanity say? And how would we recognise one if it arrived?

Davies, author of Harvest: The True Story of Alien Abduction, brings his long-standing interest in extraordinary experiences to an interview that invites listeners to consider the questions for themselves. Whether you follow UFO encounters closely or are simply curious about the possibility of life beyond Earth, the episode offers an accessible journey into one contactee’s perspective.

The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast explores ghost stories, hauntings, UFO encounters, alien experiences and other unexplained mysteries. This latest conversation takes the show from Earth’s ancient past to the possibility of a very different future.

Listen to “GET READY: The GALACTIC Community’s Message for Humanity!” now on The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast.
